items.mainDefect: ClientResource management-permissions endpoints call unsupported V2 methods, causing an unhandled exception and HTTP 500.

secondary.defect: The ClientRemovedEvent listener calls V2's unsupported setPermissionsEnabled method when both V1 and V2 are enabled, causing client deletion to throw.

items.mainDefect: ClientResource management-permissions endpoints call unsupported V2 permission methods instead of returning a safe disabled response or proper 4xx.

secondary.defect: Token exchange calls V2's unsupported canExchangeTo method instead of returning false or a proper feature-disabled response.
